title: A footprint document, as the engine answers it (FootprintDrawing)

FootprintDrawing.Body.description: A package's body over its footprint, its outline the fabrication layer's.

x.description: where it stands, millimetres right of the footprint's origin

y.description: where it stands, millimetres below the footprint's origin

height.description: how tall its letters are, millimetres

rotation.description: how far it is turned, degrees

anchor.description: which part of the letters stands on the point: start, middle — the usual — or end

FootprintDrawing.Field.description: Where a placed part's reference or value is printed, in the footprint's own frame.

rotation.description: degrees about each axis: x, y, z

scale.description: each axis' factor: x, y, z

hidden.description: whether it is kept but not shown

FootprintDrawing.Model.description: A 3D model set onto the footprint, as MODEL places it.

width.description: what its lines are stroked with, millimetres; 0 for an area filled alone

filled.description: whether it is an area rather than lines

path.description: what it draws, as path data in the footprint's millimetres

FootprintDrawing.Outline.description: A line or an area drawn on one of the footprint's layers.

number.description: the pin it is, as the part numbers its pins

shape.description: circle, rectangle, oval, trapezoid, rounded-rectangle, custom

x.description: where its middle stands, millimetres right of the footprint's origin

y.description: where its middle stands, millimetres below the footprint's origin

rotation.description: how far it is turned, degrees

drillWidth.description: its hole's width, millimetres; 0 for a pad with no hole

drillHeight.description: its hole's height, millimetres — taller than wide for a slot —; 0 for a pad with no hole

roundness.description: a rounded rectangle's corner radius, as a share of its shorter side; 0 for any other shape

path.description: a custom pad's outline; empty for any other

face.description: the side of the pcb a surface pad is on, from its part's: near — the usual — or far; empty for near

opens.description: what it leaves open over its copper: both, mask, paste or none; empty for what its type usually does

maskMargin.description: how far the solder mask stands back from its copper, millimetres; null for the pcb's own

pasteMargin.description: how far the solder paste stands back from its copper, millimetres; null for the pcb's own

platedThrough.description: Whether it is a plated hole: copper on every layer, through the pcb.

surface.description: Whether it is a surface pad: copper on its part's side alone, no hole.

unplated.description: A hole of no copper: drilled, never etched, joined to no net.

FootprintDrawing.Pad.description: A pad: where a part's pin meets the copper, or a hole drilled for it.

outlines.description: the lines and areas drawn on its layers

fields.description: where its reference and value are printed

body.description: the package's body; null when the footprint does not say

models.description: the 3D models that show the body, in their order; none when the footprint names none

description: A footprint as data a picture is painted from — its pads, its outlines and where its reference and value are printed, in millimetres from its origin, Y downwards —, and its package's body when the footprint says how high it stands: what a library browser, a pcb preview or a 3D view reads. It is data; how it is sent is the product's. The body is not a drawn line: a footprint editor neither draws nor rewrites it (classOf), so its line is kept as written while the rest is redrawn. Its models it does set, so they are written with the pads and outlines.
